title: Request IDs
hints: `context.WithValue(parent, key, val)` returns a new child context; `ctx.Value(key)` looks the key up, walking towards the root. The key is `ctxKey{}`, a value of your unexported type.
`ctx.Value(ctxKey{})` returns `any` (`nil` when missing). Turn it back into a `string` with the comma-ok type assertion so a missing value gives `"", false` instead of a panic.
`WithRequestID`: `return context.WithValue(ctx, ctxKey{}, id)`. `RequestID`: `id, ok := ctx.Value(ctxKey{}).(string); return id, ok`. `Detach`: `return context.WithoutCancel(ctx)`.
